content: Ionic React ships IonAlert and IonActionSheet out of the box (already a transitive dep via @ionic/react 8.7 in MOBILE) — no new dependency needed for MOBILE confirmation dialogs. Best practice: use role='destructive' on dangerous buttons (e.g. block user, force invoice cycle) and role='cancel' for the escape path; destructive button should be first/top in iOS mode. Use isOpen state + didDismiss/ionAlertDidDismiss listener since isOpen is one-way bound and won't auto-reset to false.
